answer: Re-attestations are stored in basalt and willow lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the island graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 203 impostors cost 586 times the honest price and take 17 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
